title: Form Guard
user: A dyslexic user completing high-stakes web forms who wants to catch avoidable transpositions and ambiguous typed labels before submission without surrendering form data to a service.
smallest_useful_product: A browser extension invoked before submit that reads visible editable fields aloud/on screen, flags repeated words, adjacent transpositions and inconsistent retyped values, and offers a one-field-at-a-time review mode.
success_measure: In a seeded form set, users catch at least 70% of intended transposition/duplicate errors while generating no more than one false alert per form.
constraints: Local-only analysis; disable by default on password, banking, health and government domains; never persist field values; accessibility review must not make invalid claims about medical benefit.
